rules.deduplication: first delivery of an event_id is authoritative; later deliveries are duplicates
rules.dual_use: signed dual-use tooling with a valid ticket but an operator mismatch remains ambiguous
rules.evidence: verify blob sha256 and predecessor custody link before preservation
rules.external_boundary: offline staging only; never isolate, disable, delete, contact, or clean an external system
rules.ordering: after identity filtering and de-duplication, highest sequence per stream is current
rules.recovery: restore interrupted before-images before one atomic local projection
rules.scope: contain only the evidenced host or session; a session signal cannot disable its account
